question: Which among the following is not an alkali metals and does not belong to the Group 1 of Periodic Table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcium.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Calcium** is **not **an alkali metal and does not belong to Group 1 of the periodic table.
 
• **Alkali metals** are **highly reactive metals** that readily lose their outermost electron to form cations with a **charge of +1.**
 
• Any of the six chemical elements in Group 1 (Ia) of the periodic table—**lithium (Li), sodium (Na), potassium (K), rubidium (Rb), cesium (Cs), and francium (Fr)**—are classified as an alkali metal.
 
• The reason the alkali metals have that name is because they react with water to produce **alkalies,** which are **powerful bases **capable of **neutralizing acids.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcium:**

 
 
• It is an **alkaline earth metal **that belongs to **Group 2** of the periodic table.
 
• The elements in **Group 2** of the periodic table have **two valence electrons** and are **less reactive **than alkali metals. 
 
 
 
• **Lithium:**
 
 
• A chemical element with the **atomic number 3** and the symbol **Li **is lithium.
 
• It is a **delicate, white-silver alkali metal.**
 
• It is the **least dense metal** and the least dense solid element under typical conditions.
 
 
 
• **Sodium:**
 
 
• The chemical element sodium has the atomic number **11** and the symbol **Na.**
 
• It is a** delicate, silvery-white meta**l that is exceedingly** reactive.**
 
 
 
• **Potassium:**
 
 
• The chemical element with the atomic number **19 **and the letter** K** is potassium.
 
• It is a** silvery white metal **that may be easily sliced with a knife thanks to its pliability.
